observations: Photo 0: Open laptop with screen covered in plastic wrap, showing reflections and smudges. HP logo visible below screen. Keyboard is black with white lettering, trackpad is centered. Palm rest area has visible scratches. A watermark 'CHIPS AND CHIPSETS TECH' is overlaid on the keyboard.
Photo 1: Side view of laptop, still wrapped in plastic. Left side shows USB ports and possibly an HDMI port. The plastic wrap is torn at the top edge. Watermark 'CHIPS AND CHIPSETS TECH' is visible.

Photo 2: Right side view of laptop, also wrapped in plastic. Shows USB ports, SD card slot, and possibly an audio jack. The plastic wrap is torn at the top. Watermark 'CHIPS AND CHIPSETS TECH' is visible.

claims.claim: Perfect and durable laptop for all computer related tasks
claims.evidence: Photos show visible scratches on palm rest and plastic wrap on screen and body, suggesting wear or handling. No proof of functionality or performance. The term 'perfect' is subjective and not supported by visual evidence.

risks.proof: Photo showing screen turned on with full display, ideally with a test pattern or white screen to reveal defects.
Video or photo of laptop powered on, showing boot process, keyboard input, and trackpad response.

risks.risk: Battery not included or not functional
risks.proof: Photo of battery being removed or connected, or video showing laptop running on battery power.

risks.risk: Plastic wrap concealing deeper damage or liquid damage
risks.proof: Photo of laptop with plastic wrap removed, showing full condition of screen, keyboard, and body.

proof_requests: Photo of laptop with plastic wrap removed, showing full condition.
Video or photo of laptop powered on, showing boot and functionality.
Photo of screen turned on with white background to check for dead pixels or damage.
Photo of battery being removed or laptop running on battery.
response.reason: The laptop is identified as HP, but the model is unreadable. The seller claims it is 'perfect and durable', but photos show scratches and plastic wrap, which may hide damage. Functionality, screen condition, and battery status are unverified. Without proof of working condition and full visibility, a worst-case price cannot be determined.
